one_line: Pre-register an out-of-sample over-suppression (false-negative) acceptance audit of every detector candidate currently staged to succeed the live class-separation guard a8c04fc31e4a, measured on the two frozen worker-049 adversarial corpora plus a new third corpus authored before any candidate read it, with the worker-098 declared fire/clean/growth controls re-scored independently. Read-only on all pinned inputs; no canonical write; no adopt/reject decision.
why_this_task: The standing G-AUDIT blocker from W049-CLASSSEP-FN-AUDIT-01 (comms/outbox/worker-049.jsonl, event w049-fnaudit-20260912T0056-blocker-guard) states the acceptance test for any successor: 0 cue-induced false negatives on corpus v1 and corpus v2 with both corpora unchanged, worker-07 corpus 17/0/10/0 PASS, worker-098 declared FP probes clean, growth 0, and declaration-mode diff vs c266 reported and justified. The lead adjudication astra-life05-classsep-calibration requires a measured census and an adopt/reject recommendation, and astra assignment human-pi-detector-fix-20260912T0100 authorizes the narrowest context-aware fix. This audit supplies the independent out-of-sample numbers for that decision; it does not make it.
candidate_discovery_rule: The runner reads candidates_pinned.json (written immediately before execution from an explicit glob of artifacts/worker-098/classsep_mention_scope/candidate_class_separation*.py plus the fixed paths below). Every module is imported by path and identified by measured sha256, never by name. If the glob set or any hash changes between module load and the end-of-run drift check, results are written but flagged candidate_set_drift=true and verdicts are marked VOID; rerun required.

worker098_declared_controls.verification: the runner verifies every copied control text is a literal substring of the pinned source file before scoring, so the copy cannot silently diverge from the declaration

primary_endpoint: Per detector and per corpus, cue-induced false negatives = ADVERSARIAL_ASSERTION fixtures that produce 0 findings while their TWIN_CONTROL produces >=1 finding on the same detector. Acceptance requires 0 on corpus v1, corpus v2 and corpus v3 simultaneously, with all three corpus hashes unchanged.
secondary_endpoints: mention_fp per detector per corpus (diagnostic; not gated)
declaration-mode finding-count diff vs recovered_c266 per fixture (gated to 0 for candidates declaring prose-only scope; reported for all)
live-map hard finding count per detector at a pinned map snapshot (diagnostic)
overall_verdict_rule: ACCEPTANCE_PASS iff (a) cue_induced_fn_total == 0 on corpora v1, v2, v3; (b) worker-07 == 17/0/10/0 PASS; (c) all worker-098 FIRE controls fire and all CLEAN controls are silent and all GROWTH controls return 0 findings; (d) declaration diff == 0 for candidates whose build manifest declares declaration_mode_touched=false (worker-098 v1/v2/v3) and reported for the others. Otherwise FAIL with the failed gate ids. Verdicts are VOID if candidate set or input hashes drift during the run.
falsifier: The audit is falsified if, at the pinned hashes, any candidate marked ACCEPTANCE_PASS produces a cue-induced false negative on any of the three corpora, fails the worker-07 corpus, fires a CLEAN control, clears a FIRE control, or (for a prose-scoped candidate) changes declaration-mode findings. The claim that the corpora are out-of-sample is falsified if any adversarial fixture text appears in any detector, candidate, or battery file written before corpus_v3.json (substring search over the tree, excluding this task's own directory).
non_claims: no gate verdict, no node status, no validation_status
no adopt/reject recommendation: the numbers are for the audit lead's adjudication
no natural-text FN/FP rate: all corpora are adversarial by construction
no edit to any canonical, staged, or pinned file; the runner is read-only on all inputs
no claim about who applied the live guard a8c04fc3 or with what authority
